name: Muhammad Iqbal
shortBio: South Asian Islamic philosopher-poet whose Reconstruction of Religious Thought in Islam synthesized classical Islamic philosophy, Rumi, Bergson, and Nietzsche into a dynamic metaphysics of creative selfhood (Khudi) and ijtihad.
centralQuestion: How can Islamic philosophy recover dynamic creativity and moral agency (Khudi) by uniting spiritual intuition with modern scientific and democratic reason?

keyWorks.title: The Reconstruction of Religious Thought in Islam
keyWorks.description: Systematic philosophical lectures reinterpreting Islamic epistemology, dynamic time, human egohood, and legal ijtihad.

keyWorks.title: The Secrets of the Self (Asrar-i-Khudi)
keyWorks.description: Philosophical poetry rejecting passive self-negation in favor of active, world-transforming ego cultivation (Khudi).
